notes.note_R1: RETROSPECTIVE MACRO AVAILABILITY. The CGMacros dictionary defines Calories/Carbs/Protein/Fat/Fiber as quantities 'in the consumed meal', and `Amount Consumed` as the percentage eaten, derived from an END-of-meal photograph taken a median 16 minutes AFTER the meal. The logged macros therefore describe what was actually eaten. In deployment the equivalent input is a participant's PLANNED or logged-at-the-time meal, which is prospectively available but may differ from what they finish. This is a known EVALUATION LIMITATION of the dataset and of the task as specified -- it is not a model-integrity failure, and fs-1.3 has always received these five fields. Reported accuracy must not be presented as proof that exact consumed quantities are knowable before eating.
notes.note_C1: CAUSAL HISTORY. Fingerprint and retrieval features use only earlier meals whose whole 120-minute response window elapsed STRICTLY before t, which is verified empirically above and in tests/test_freeze_retrieval_audit.py. A response window ending exactly AT t is EXCLUDED.
